Invalid free and uninitialized-value in XInclude processing: while processing XInclude nodes (xmlXIncludeDoProcess in xinclude.c), libxml2's node-copy/free path (xmlStaticCopyNode/xmlFreeNode/xmlFreeNodeList/xmlFreeDoc in tree.c) attempts to free a pointer that was not returned by malloc (free on an interior address of an allocated block), causing heap corruption and crashes.
